evals.prompt: Replace the @capacitor-mlkit/barcode-scanning scanner in my React wallet app with Scandit SparkScan. scanQrCode() in utils.ts requests camera permission, waits for the Google barcode module, calls BarcodeScanner.scan() with no formats and returns the first DID found in a scanned value (or null); main.tsx installs the Google module on start-up. Files: utils.ts, main.tsx.
evals.expected_output: The skill reads references/third-party-migration.md. scanQrCode() keeps its signature and result (DID string or null) and keeps the permission gate (returning null when denied). scan() becomes a promise wrapper around one reused DataCaptureContext/SparkScan/SparkScanView that resolves on the first didScan and resolves with empty barcodes on cancel (didChangeViewState), never via didTapBarcodeCountButton. The Google module availability/install code in utils.ts and main.tsx is removed. Because the original passed no formats, the recommended default symbology set is enabled, not just QR.

assertions.text: The import from '@capacitor-mlkit/barcode-scanning' (static or dynamic import()) is removed from the migrated code
BarcodeScanner.scan( is not present in the migrated code
await ScanditCaptureCorePlugin.initializePlugins() is present and awaited before any other Scandit call
SparkScanView.forContext( is used and the first didScan resolves the promise returned by the scan wrapper with a { barcodes: [...] } shape (semantic)

The wrapper resolves with an empty barcodes array when the user cancels, driven by SparkScanView uiListener didChangeViewState (Idle after Active, never Inactive) and/or an app-callable cancel, so the caller never hangs (semantic)
didTapBarcodeCountButton, didTapBarcodeFindButton and didTapLabelCaptureButton are not used to detect a close or cancel
DataCaptureContext.initialize( is called once and reused across scans, not re-initialised on every scan call (semantic)
The view is stopped and hidden (stopScanning / hide) after a result or cancel
Symbology.QR is enabled and the enabled set is not narrower than the original ML Kit formats; 'Symbology.QRCode' is not used
Summary lists the scanning UI change (full-screen scanner to SparkScan trigger button / mini preview) as a judgment call to confirm
isGoogleBarcodeScannerModuleAvailable and installGoogleBarcodeScannerModule are removed from utils.ts and main.tsx, with no replacement module-install step
scanQrCode still returns a DID string or null and still returns null when camera permission is denied (permission gate kept, not faked as granted)
Because the original scan() passed no formats, more than QR is enabled (the recommended default set: EAN13UPCA, Code128, DataMatrix, ... in addition to QR)
extractDid and the loop over barcodes using rawValue are preserved unchanged (semantic)
